params.convention: negative delta = toward reward A; delta_learn = postLearn-pred; delta_ext = postExt-postLearn

contrast_near_over_far.note: mean/SD are skewed by 1-2 seeds with a near-zero far-bin denominator; median/IQR is the headline statistic. Paired Wilcoxon (rank-based) is unaffected by this skew.
